Scholarship overview

The Leeds Access to Research Scholarship supports eligible home-fee applicants from specified minority ethnic backgrounds. It is a doctoral funding competition with widening participation criteria, rather than a scholarship open to all applicants worldwide.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Leeds research subjects
  • Doctoral study
  • Research training

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference rate)

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityEligible UK home-fee minority ethnic applicants
Further conditionsUK home-fee applicants from eligible Black, Asian and minority ethnic backgrounds.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round23 March 2027, 17:00 UK time
LocationUnited Kingdom
Details checked9 October 2026

About the University of Leeds

Leeds offers research degrees through its schools, institutes and doctoral training programmes. Its funding routes include subject-specific studentships, university scholarships and awards with particular nationality or widening participation criteria.
